Class MessageLockCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.MessageLockCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class MessageLockCommand extends Object implements Command
The MessageLockCommand type is the message lock command. The command locks the next open sequence number in the eligible run. A miss leaves the packed prefix unchanged. The command has no aliases.

    • getDescription

      public String getDescription()
      The getDescription method returns the longer help text. The text says the command locks the first eligible sequence number that is still open. The text says a miss leaves the prefix. The example in the text is message lock 2.
      Specified by:

    • execute

      public void execute(CommandContext ctx, String args) throws Exception
      The execute method locks one sequence number. seq(String, String) parses the argument as the sequence number for message lock. The head count comes from the chat properties. The head count is how many leading messages stay packed. If
      invalid reference 
      ChatSession#lockMessage
      returns a message, the method throws Exception with that message. If the lock succeeds, the method writes locked plus the sequence number. The written line ends with a carriage return and a line feed.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Command
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The sequence number was missing, or the session refused the lock.

    • seq

      static long seq(String args, String command) throws Exception
      The seq method parses one sequence number from a command remainder. If args is null or blank, the method throws Exception with Usage: , the command name, and <seq>. If the trimmed text is not a decimal long, the method throws the same usage exception.
      Parameters:
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      command - The command name placed in the usage message.
      Returns:
      The parsed sequence number.
      Throws:
      Exception - The remainder was blank or was not a number.
